description: Static security scan of a Next.js + Supabase codebase: secrets in code or public env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_), service role keys in client code, RLS off or open policies in supabase/migrations, unauthenticated API routes, Server Actions and Edge Functions, unsafe redirects and more. Send source files (ts, tsx, js, jsx, sql, .env*, config files) with paths relative to the project root; skip node_modules, build output and lockfiles. Up to 300 files and 4 MB per call; split bigger projects. Files are scanned in memory and discarded.

path.description: Path relative to the project root, e.g. app/api/user/route.ts

ignore.description: Optional contents of a .guardlayerignore (gitignore syntax) to skip fixtures.

name: scan_files
title: Scan code for security issues
